credential_boundary: The owner publishes the workflow timeout change. The updater App keeps contents/pull-request permissions only and adds this meaningful provenance record as the final reviewable push.
reason: The synthetic NAT46 return packet has source 10.250.0.20, but its fixture omitted the translator-pool return route. The kernel discarded that packet before inet forwarding and the target-ownership predicates. Add the same route supplied by real translator geometry, keeping all ownership, expiry, tamper and packet-drop assertions.

trigger.failure: synthetic routed packet was not delivered

validation.baseline: Reproduced the hosted failure in a new empty user/network namespace.
validation.trace: The IPv6 forward packet passed its ownership gate. The IPv4 return packet was visible at netdev ingress and never reached inet forwarding.
validation.with_return_route: The original delivery failure is eliminated and execution reaches later privileged mutation probes. Those probes require the hosted initial-user-namespace capabilities; the local nested user namespace rejects payload mutation. Full exact-head hosted validation remains required.

workflow_change: Allow 30 minutes for the two required cold kernel suites; the prior shared 10-minute budget was almost consumed by the first suite alone. Required jobs and assertions are unchanged.
